import os, subprocess, re

ROOT = "/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul"
os.chdir(ROOT)

# Gather core sources, excluding disabled importers
core = []
for dp, dn, fn in os.walk("code"):
    for f in fn:
        if f.endswith(".cpp"):
            p = os.path.join(dp, f)
            if re.search(r"C4D|M3D|Usd|USD|VRML|Wrl|Vrml", p):
                continue
            core.append(p)
core.sort()

contrib = [
    "contrib/pugixml/src/pugixml.cpp",
    "contrib/openddlparser/code/OpenDDLCommon.cpp",
    "contrib/openddlparser/code/OpenDDLParser.cpp",
    "contrib/openddlparser/code/OpenDDLStream.cpp",
    "contrib/poly2tri/poly2tri/common/shapes.cpp",
    "contrib/poly2tri/poly2tri/sweep/advancing_front.cpp",
    "contrib/poly2tri/poly2tri/sweep/cdt.cpp",
    "contrib/poly2tri/poly2tri/sweep/sweep_context.cpp",
    "contrib/poly2tri/poly2tri/sweep/sweep.cpp",
    "contrib/clipper/clipper.cpp",
    "contrib/unzip/ioapi.c",
    "contrib/unzip/unzip.c",
    "contrib/zip/src/zip.c",
    "contrib/Open3DGC/o3dgcTools.cpp",
    "contrib/Open3DGC/o3dgcDynamicVectorDecoder.cpp",
    "contrib/Open3DGC/o3dgcArithmeticCodec.cpp",
    "contrib/Open3DGC/o3dgcTriangleFans.cpp",
    "contrib/Open3DGC/o3dgcDynamicVectorEncoder.cpp",
]
# zlib
for dp, dn, fn in os.walk("contrib/zlib"):
    for f in fn:
        if f.endswith(".c"):
            contrib.append(os.path.join(dp, f))

allsrc = core + contrib

includes = [
    "-Iinclude",
    "-Icode",
    "-Icode/..",
    "-Icontrib/pugixml/src",
    "-Icontrib/openddlparser/include",
    "-Icontrib/poly2tri",
    "-Icontrib/clipper",
    "-Icontrib/unzip",
    "-Icontrib/zip/src",
    "-Icontrib/Open3DGC",
    "-Icontrib/zlib",
    "-Icontrib",
    "-Icontrib/rapidjson/include",
    "-Icontrib/utf8cpp/include",
    "-Icontrib/stb",
]

defines = [
    "-DASSIMP_BUILD_NO_C4D_IMPORTER",
    "-DASSIMP_BUILD_NO_M3D_EXPORTER",
    "-DASSIMP_BUILD_NO_M3D_IMPORTER",
    "-DASSIMP_BUILD_NO_USD_IMPORTER",
    "-DASSIMP_BUILD_NO_VRML_IMPORTER",
    "-DASSIMP_IMPORTER_GLTF_USE_OPEN3DGC=1",
    "-DMINIZ_USE_UNALIGNED_LOADS_AND_STORES=0",
    "-DOPENDDLPARSER_BUILD",
    "-DOPENDDL_STATIC_LIBARY",
    "-DP2T_STATIC_EXPORTS",
    "-DRAPIDJSON_HAS_STDSTRING=1",
    "-DRAPIDJSON_NOMEMBERITERATORCLASS",
    "-DASSIMP_BUILD_DLL_EXPORT",  # actually we want static; but headers use ASSIMP_API. For static, define nothing. Let's NOT define DLL_EXPORT.
]

# Remove the DLL export define for static build
defines = [d for d in defines if d != "-DASSIMP_BUILD_DLL_EXPORT"]

CXX = "g++"
CC = "gcc"
CFLAGS = "-O1 -g -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -fno-exceptions -std=c++17 -Wno-everything"
# Actually keep exceptions (assimp uses them). Remove -fno-exceptions.
CFLAGS = "-O1 -g -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -std=c++17 -Wno-everything"

lines = []
lines.append("CXX = " + CXX)
lines.append("CC = " + CC)
lines.append("CFLAGS = " + CFLAGS)
lines.append("INCLUDES = " + " ".join(includes))
lines.append("DEFINES = " + " ".join(defines))
lines.append("BUILDDIR = /tmp/assimp-obj")
lines.append("LIB = /tmp/assimp-obj/libassimp.a")
lines.append("")
# object list
objs = []
for s in allsrc:
    o = s.replace("/", "_").replace(".cpp", ".o").replace(".c", ".o")
    o = "$(BUILDDIR)/" + o
    objs.append(o)
lines.append("OBJS = " + " ".join(objs))
lines.append("")
lines.append("all: $(LIB) /tmp/assimp-obj/harness")
lines.append("")
lines.append("$(BUILDDIR):")
lines.append("\tmkdir -p $(BUILDDIR)")
lines.append("")
# pattern rules per source
for s, o in zip(allsrc, objs):
    if s.endswith(".c"):
        comp = "$(CC) $(CFLAGS) $(INCLUDES) $(DEFINES) -c " + s + " -o " + o
    else:
        comp = "$(CXX) $(CFLAGS) $(INCLUDES) $(DEFINES) -c " + s + " -o " + o
    lines.append(o + ": " + s + " | $(BUILDDIR)")
    lines.append("\t" + comp)
    lines.append("")
lines.append("$(LIB): $(OBJS)")
lines.append("\tar rcs $@ $^")
lines.append("")
# harness
lines.append("/tmp/assimp-obj/harness: /tmp/assimp-obj/harness.o $(LIB)")
lines.append("\t$(CXX) $(CFLAGS) $< $(LIB) -lstdc++ -lm -lpthread -o $@")
lines.append("")
lines.append("/tmp/assimp-obj/harness.o: /workspace/harness_main.cc | $(BUILDDIR)")
lines.append("\t$(CXX) $(CFLAGS) $(INCLUDES) $(DEFINES) -c /workspace/harness_main.cc -o $@")
lines.append("")

with open("/tmp/Makefile.assimp", "w") as f:
    f.write("\n".join(lines))
print("Wrote Makefile with", len(allsrc), "sources")
